verdict.rationale: The docs include copy-and-run commands in the getting-started tutorial and advertise code samples, so the 'runnable examples' half of the story has some first-party support. Nothing shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer or try-it console, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any standard path. missing for 10: an interactive API reference or try-it console, a published OpenAPI spec, and evidence that examples can be executed directly from the reference.
